parsed.rationale: All three types — `SheetDraggingKey` in `WXUI/OverlaySheet.swift`, `ThemePickerActiveKey` in `Wallpaper/ThemePickerState.swift`, and `UITestingModeKey` also in `Wallpaper/ThemePickerState.swift` — are `type-alias-object` declarations with empty `fields_or_signature`. The structural match (shared_field_count: 1, no differing_slots, no Jaccard score) indicates they share only the trivial shape of a zero-field type alias, not any meaningful domain logic. Each name encodes a distinct SwiftUI `EnvironmentKey` identity (sheet dragging state, theme picker activation, and UI-testing mode respectively), so their coincidence is purely structural. Merging or extracting them would conflate unrelated domain concepts and destroy the intentional per-key type identity that SwiftUI's environment system requires.
